note: The home realm (roster name) of each character that an in-game effect brings into play and that no court of data/world/characters lists. The character is recruited without a role in that realm's history and moved by set_nationality to the realm that brings it in. A character of a court is recruited by its court's realm and needs no row here.

zin_aenor_captains_regency.why: The Captains' Regency rules Aenor while Eindil is lost (Aenor court spec).

zin_aenor_concord_speaker.why: The Concord's speaker rules Aenor when the dominions take the throne (Aenor court spec).

zin_aenor_golden_regency.why: The Golden Regency rules Aenor when the court takes the throne (Aenor court spec).

zin_kusven.why: Kusven is Zol's servant and takes the field from the Mistake (Zol's Mistake spec, K29).

zin_eindil.why: Eindil lies in the ice of the far north-west (zin_is_site_eindil_ice: the Cold Lands state farthest from Fandanar within the far north-west, key sites spec); Kvittumm is the realm of the far north-west. Proposed: the site trigger is still a stand-in, and the journey moves him to whichever realm finds him.
